name: Irawati Karve
shortBio: Pioneering Indian sociologist and anthropologist who mapped regional kinship structures, caste endogamy, and linguistic geography across India while reading the Mahabharata as secular human ethics.
centralQuestion: How do regional kinship regimes and caste-marriage networks shape moral obligation, gender status, and social cohesion across Indian civilization?

keyWorks.title: Kinship Organisation in India
keyWorks.description: Foundational comparative sociological analysis of northern, southern, and eastern Indian kinship systems and women’s household agency.

keyWorks.title: Yuganta: The End of an Epoch
keyWorks.description: Anthropological and secular-humanist re-reading of Mahabharata figures as historical moral agents rather than mythic archetypes.
